description.value: Prestige Mountain Resort is a full-service hotel in the mountain town of Rossland, tucked between the Monashee and Selkirk ranges and five minutes from some of BC's best ski and mountain bike terrain. The resort offers on-site dining in a restaurant, lounge, and cafe with a patio overlooking the valley, plus indoor hot tub and sauna for recovery after a hard day in the saddle. As part of the family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain, it provides a professionally managed, amenity-rich base for touring cyclists exploring the Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms this is an active, open hotel. The amenities page explicitly lists 'Secure Bike and Ski Lockers' and 'Complimentary Wi-Fi' under Hotel Features & Amenities. An on-site restaurant, lounge, and cafe confirm nearby evening food. No mention of laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, or other cycle-specific amenities beyond the lockers.
